presentations.name: Talent Scheduling with Daily Capacity and Changeover Times: A Pattern Based Integer Linear Programming Approach
presentations.event: Directed Reading Program with the Mathematics Department at the University of Georgia
presentations.description: Presented an ILP model for talent scheduling with daily capacity and changeover times, implemented in Python with Gurobi.

portfolio.name: Talent Scheduling with Daily Capacity and Changeover Times
portfolio.description: Replicated an integer linear programming (ILP) model for a talent scheduling problem with daily capacity and changeover times. Implemented in Python with Gurobi and analyzed solution feasibility, constraint interactions, and scalability.

portfolio.name: Simple Optimal Control of a Reparable System
portfolio.description: Modeled a two-state repair/failure system using ODEs and implemented a backward-Euler discretization with adjoint-based gradient descent in Python to optimize a non-negative control input.
